# Negative-assertion fixture for `stats-code --help` output.
#
# This file is consumed by task 1.5's unit test (`cli_help_hides_subcommands`).
# Each non-empty / non-comment line is a token that MUST NOT appear in the help
# text rendered by `stats-code --help`.
#
# Source: single-command-launcher spec, Requirements 2.2 / 2.4 / 2.5.
#   - Requirement 2.2: `stats-code --help` only lists `--version`, `--help`,
#     `--no-browser`.
#   - Requirement 2.4: none of the internal algorithm subcommands are visible.
#   - Requirement 2.5: SkillInvoker still resolves these subcommands when called
#     by name; they are hidden, not removed.
#
# Format: one forbidden token per line. Lines starting with `#` are comments.
# Tokens are matched as case-sensitive substrings against the help text body.

# Top-level subcommand names from `Command` enum:
chat
